    Procedure images (7)

    Use a fixed camera (tripod) with the same distance, zoom and lighting in every image, with the field centred in the frame. Landscape 16:9 at 1920×1080 or larger works best. Images that are not 16:9 are cropped from the centre. Keep instruments out of the frame if possible, and do not move the eyelid between images 2 and 6.
